text:
marta: saw a p99 tail in continuous-batcher for ~3m, looks tied to tenant 'alpha' burst. thinking about per-tenant micro-lanes vs shared lanes + soft isolation. quick thoughts?
kieran: numbers?
marta: p50 ~12ms, p99 120->820ms. enqueue shows long wait. logs:
[15:12:01] enqueue tenant=alpha tokens=180 wait_ms=742 queue_len=67
joy: micro-lanes isolate but fragment GPUs.
ben: summary: micro-lane = isolation + complexity; shared + soft-isolation = packing + harder eviction.
kieran: telemetry adds work (lane histograms).
joy: propose "burst tickets" per tenant that regen slowly to cap short spikes.
ben: tickets keep packing but risk slow-bleed from many small reqs. need leak detection.
derek: safe path: (1) add telemetry behind FF, (2) try tickets on 10% tenants, (3) fallback to micro-lanes for a cohort. Canary criteria?
marta: rollback if p99 >2x or occupancy drop >15%. also add deadline_bias to coalesce (favor low deadline_hint / small token_est).
ben: token_est variance may misorder, log misorders.
derek: keep API stable; internal FF only.
ops-bot: incident IN-2026-03-22-11 created.
marta: TODOs: kieran telemetry schema; joy simulate tickets; ben draft eviction change; derek runbook. TL;DR: soft-reservation + deadline_bias first, micro-lanes if needed. :thumbsup:
